sloka: अत्र किम्पुरुषीर्भूत्वा शैलरोधसि वत्स्यथ ।आवासस्तु गिरावस्मिञ्छीघ्रमेव विधीयताम् ।। ७.८८.२२ ॥
transliteration: atra kimpuruṣīrbhūtvā śailarodhasi vatsyatha ।āvāsastu girāvasmiñchīghrameva vidhīyatām ।। 7.88.22 ॥

translations.english: You shall dwell here on the mountain slope, becoming Kimpurushis, and a dwelling place on this mountain should be arranged quickly.
